subject: world_language
concept: Expanding academic and abstract vocabulary beyond everyday conversational words
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches an academic/abstract target-language term to its definition
exercise.abstract: Student uses a newly learned academic or abstract term correctly in an original sentence

misconception_flags: uses a newly learned abstract term in a grammatically or contextually incorrect way

interest_binding: vocabulary set generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
